requirement.requirement_text: The system fetches news articles from the BBC website. It filters articles based on their suitability for a podcast, categorizing them with an LLM. For each selected article, the system shall: (1) extract the full content of the article; (2) use a language model to create a podcast script; (3) convert the script to speech using a text-to-speech service. Visible outcome: the final podcast audio is ready for use. Failure handling: not specified in the public description.

source_spans.text: The workflow fetches news articles from the BBC website.
It filters articles based on their suitability for a podcast.
It extracts the full content of the selected articles.
It uses Gemini LLM to create a podcast script.
It converts the script to speech using Hugging Face's text-to-speech model.
The final podcast audio is ready for use.
